integrity: Exact analytical arguments are provided. Finite computational checks corroborate but are not used as infinite proofs. Primary spectral calculations are explicit tensor decompositions; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact all-profile graph and spectral claims require complete consecutive-layer transitions and original arc-incidence coordinates. The distance phase transition is for uniform layer sizes. The binary distance-regular graph is a classical halved cube under the exhibited isomorphism, and the general path-adjacency criterion is established prior work. The full 1992 primary text was unavailable; bibliographic equivalence elsewhere is possible.
title: A sharp alphabet transition in the skeleton metrics of complete layered path polytopes
